name: council
description: Six-seat decision council + /council skill for the claude-md config. Pure reasoners (Read/Grep/Glob only, no network, no Agent tool, no CLAUDE.md load — the convener passes each seat the question, the minimum project context and matching REGRESSIONS.md rows); the main session fans a question to the seats and the chair synthesizes a verdict. Chat fallback: where sub-agents aren't available (Claude chat, the Desktop Chat tab, mobile), /council runs the five seats sequentially and blind, then the chair synthesis. No hooks or scripts — agents and one skill only.
